note: A missing or expired entry refuses paid egress. The dated L4C3 entry below covers one exact OpenRouter model and route; execution remains disabled by default. Its separate stagingAlpha record authorizes only the Cloud Staging Alpha scope and does not widen Smoke or resident Worker authorization.
